name: Menu Drop
description:
Menu Drop is a free lightweight macOS utility developed by Sindre Sorhus that brings quick, drag-and-drop AirDrop sharing directly to your Mac's menu bar.

Core Features
✱ Drag-and-Drop Sharing: Drag files, images, links, or text straight onto the app's menu bar icon to trigger the system AirDrop window immediately.
✱ Safari Integration: You can drag a URL right out of the Safari address bar and drop it onto the icon to send it over.
✱ Share from Clipboard: Fast-track sharing by sending whatever text or media is currently on your clipboard via customizable hotkeys.
✱ Share from Files: Quickly launch a file picker directly from the menu bar to select specific documents.
✱ Local Security: Built without internet permissions, meaning your data never leaves Apple's native, sandboxed AirDrop framework.
